name: asdf
description_en: Extendable version manager with support for Ruby, Node.js, Elixir, Erlang & more
readme_excerpt: asdf Manage multiple runtime versions with a single CLI tool, extendable via plugins - docs at asdf-vm.com asdf is a CLI tool that can manage multiple language runtime versions on a per-project basis. It is like gvm, nvm, rbenv & pyenv (and more) all in one! Simply install your language's plugin! Why use asdf? - single CLI for multiple languages - consistent commands to manage all your languages - single global config keeping defaults in one place - single .tool-versions config file per project…
